verdict.rationale: PayPal exposes webhooks that fire HTTPS notifications on transaction/dispute/subscription events (paypal-docs-9, paypal-docs-28) and offers a Disputes API for automating response actions (paypal-docs-7, paypal-docs-26), but there is no documented no-code 'rules engine' where an AI-native user declaratively defines 'on event X do action Y' — developers must write their own listener/backend logic to consume webhooks and trigger downstream actions. Missing for 10: a native declarative rules/automation builder, evidence of AI agents autonomously subscribing to webhooks and executing conditional actions, and any no-code event-to-action mapping UI.
